name: seatbelt
description: A patient senior developer for people who build apps with AI: safe defaults, plain-language pauses at risky moments, a project notebook, and a crash-test readiness grade.

interface.shortDescription: Safe, clean AI-built apps for people who do not code
interface.longDescription: Seatbelt makes the agent pause at risky moments (secrets, login, payments, users' data, repeated failed fixes), explain every choice in plain words, keep a project notebook, and grade how ready the app is before launch.
defaultPrompt: Is my app ready to launch? Run crash-test.
Explain what you just changed, in plain words.
